note: Lane G proposals in the evidence/requirements.json requirement shape. Merge into the requirements array, then run npm run requirements.

requirements.statement: A campaign plan MUST be signed by the capture issuer and commit to the campaign ID, use case, profile and scenario-set digests, ordered planned attempts, evaluator digest, policy digest, adapter declaration and an explicitly supplied creation time, and MUST reject duplicate attempt IDs and malformed attempts.

tests.title: campaign plan commits to attempts, digests and issuer before any attempt
campaign plan rejects malformed attempts and duplicate attempt IDs

requirements.statement: A campaign ledger MUST reject out-of-order transitions and duplicate attempt IDs, and MUST reject any entry timed before the plan commitment or before the previous entry.

tests.title: campaign ledger rejects out-of-order transitions and duplicate attempt IDs
campaign ledger rejects entries before the plan commitment and time regression

requirements.statement: Campaign ledger verification MUST detect edited, removed, reordered or re-planned history through the entry hash chain and signatures, and appending to a ledger that fails verification MUST be refused.

tests.title: campaign ledger detects edited removed and reordered history

requirements.statement: A campaign ledger MUST be signed only by the key declared in its plan, and when a policy is supplied that key MUST be an unrevoked capture-issuer anchor.

tests.title: campaign ledger rejects a foreign signer and requires the capture issuer role under policy

requirements.statement: Campaign summaries MUST report unconditional counts of planned, completed, errored, abandoned and unaccounted attempts, and MUST keep every unaccounted attempt in the planned denominator.

tests.title: campaign summary keeps unaccounted attempts in the denominator

requirements.statement: A completed ledger entry MUST reference the run ID and the digest of its raw-evidence bundle, and the ledger MUST NOT store prompts, responses or free text.

tests.title: campaign completed entry requires run ID and bundle digest and rejects stored prompts or outputs

requirements.statement: A retry MUST be a new planned attempt added by a signed amendment entry, and the retried errored attempt MUST remain in the counts.

tests.title: campaign retry is a signed amendment that keeps the errored attempt counted

requirements.statement: Policy validation MUST accept the capture-issuer role, MUST NOT accept the calibrator or anchor-operator roles yet, and policies without the new role MUST keep identical digests.

tests.title: capture issuer role is accepted by policy validation and legacy policies keep their digest
policy schema describes the capture issuer role

requirements.statement: A capture-issuer key MUST NOT be an evidence signer or the evaluator key, and a capture-issuer anchor MUST NOT satisfy independence.

tests.title: capture issuer key cannot be an evidence signer or the evaluator key and never counts as independent

requirements.statement: The campaign runner MUST execute planned attempts one at a time through runConformance, MUST write raw evidence bundles with 0600 permissions only to a private directory outside the repository, and MUST refuse a private directory open to group or others.

tests.title: campaign runner executes planned attempts through conformance and writes private 0600 bundles
campaign runner refuses private directories inside the repository or open to others

requirements.statement: The campaign runner MUST refuse to start an attempt without a verified signed planned entry and MUST refuse adapter provenance or evaluator digests that differ from the plan.

tests.title: campaign runner refuses adapter provenance that differs from the plan
campaign runner refuses an attempt without a signed planned entry and an unverifiable ledger
campaign runner persists the started entry before the adapter runs

requirements.statement: The campaign runner MUST record infrastructure errors and timeouts as errored entries and MUST NOT retry an errored attempt without a signed amendment.

tests.title: campaign runner records infrastructure errors as errored and never retries silently

requirements.statement: The campaign CLI SHOULD run end to end on owned fixture adapters with an explicit clock, no network and unknown flags refused.

tests.title: campaign runner completes against the owned command fixture without network
campaign CLI plans runs verifies and summarizes on the reference adapter
campaign CLI refuses a missing clock unknown flags and unknown commands
